Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_BarrelDefaultCap: Maximum liquid units for newly initialized barrels. Existing barrels keep their saved capacity.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_BarrelEmptyWeigh: Base weight used for empty barrels and carried barrel items.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MaxInteractionDi: Maximum distance, in tiles, for barrel interactions.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_OpenBarrelRequir: Full item types, separated by commas or semicolons, that can open sealed barrels. Invalid or empty lists fall back to the default tools.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_RequireFunnelToP: If enabled, players need a funnel to pour liquids into barrels.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_RequireHoseToExt: If enabled, players need a rubber hose to fill containers from barrels.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_IndustrialWeight: Relative chance for industrial barrels to be empty. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain clean water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain tainted water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain gasoline. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Relative chance for industrial barrels to contain bleach. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightEm: Relative chance for military barrels to be empty. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightWa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain clean water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightTa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain tainted water. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightGa: Relative chance for military barrels to contain gasoline. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_MilitaryWeightBl: Relative chance for military barrels to contain bleach. Set to 0 to disable this result.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightEmp: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to be empty. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightWat: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain clean water. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightTai: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain tainted water. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightGas: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain gasoline. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_BarrelsExpanded_CraftedWeightBle: Relative chance for world-crafted barrels to contain bleach. Player-crafted barrels always start empty.
